name: Sorrel

schedule.notes: Or start indoors 4 weeks earlier. Picks a spot once — perennial 4 to 6 years.
Pick outer leaves at 4 to 6 in; bright lemony tang. Cut flower stalks to keep leaves coming.

harvest.cues: Leaves 4 to 6 in, arrowhead-shaped, bright green. Avoid older leaves — they get tough.
harvest.storageNotes: Wilts fast — best fresh. Fridge in damp paper towel 3 to 5 days. Doesn't dry well.

varieties.name: Common Garden Sorrel
varieties.notes: Large arrowhead leaves, tangy. Most productive type.

varieties.name: Blood-veined Sorrel
varieties.notes: Striking deep-red veins. Slightly milder. Beautiful in salads.

notes: Sour from oxalic acid — eat in moderation if prone to kidney stones. Classic in French sorrel soup. Trim flower stalks promptly to redirect energy back to leaves.
